Family Law Mediation
Services in Sydney

What is Mediation?

Family Law Mediation provides an effective alternative to court proceedings for resolving family law disputes, including parenting and/or financial matters. As qualified family lawyers acting as neutral facilitators, we guide parties through structured confidential discussions to reach practical agreements. Unlike court proceedings, where a judge makes decisions for you, our mediation service keeps you in control of the outcome while benefiting from professional legal guidance. The process is entirely confidential, often faster, more cost effective and less adversarial than litigation. Our highly trained mediators will help identify issues and explore options with both parties, but cannot impose a solution.

The Mediation Process At Nolan Family Lawyers we understand that every family law matter is different.
Our approach is tailored to your specific needs and circumstances.

Pre-Mediation Conference

We conduct a brief conference with each party to discuss the mediation process, confirm suitability, and address any preliminary matters.

Family Law Mediation Session

Structured discussion facilitated by an experienced family lawyer-mediator, focusing on reaching practical solutions that work for all parties.

When Mediation
is Appropriate?

Mediation works effectively when:

  • Both parties are willing to participate in good faith
  • There are no safety concerns or power imbalances
  • Parties can communicate reasonably with professional assistance

Mediation may not be suitable where:

  • Family violence or abuse is present
  • One party cannot participate meaningfully
  • Urgent court intervention is required

Common Questions on Mediation

Do I need a lawyer present during mediation?

Not necessarily, but you should receive independent legal advice before attending mediation. We can recommend experienced family lawyers if needed.

How do I know you are the right mediation specialist for me?

Our mediators combine deep family law expertise with compassion to help you reach resolution without unnecessary stress.

How confidential is the process?

Completely confidential. Nothing discussed in mediation can be used in subsequent proceedings including court

What happens if we don't reach full agreement?

Partial agreements are common and still valuable. Any unresolved issues can be addressed through further negotiation or court proceedings if necessary

Can mediation agreements be made legally binding?

Yes, agreement reached in mediation can be formalised by way of consent orders or a binding financial agreement through an experienced family lawyer

What facilities do Nolan Family Law & Mediation provide for Mediation?

We provide dedicated rooms specifically equipped for mediations as well as light refreshments and catering
